title: Review, CI & Cloud
description: codex review, codex exec in CI, and Codex Cloud run the same agent loop unattended on real work; review mode emits structured JSON findings.

steps.annotation: codex review starts the same loop in a reviewer stance, pointed at a diff instead of a chat turn.

steps.content: collect change: git diff main...HEAD -> build the review prompt with the diff as context
steps.annotation: The harness gathers the change and primes the reviewer before the first model call.

steps.content: I'll check correctness, test coverage, and risky patterns in this diff.
steps.annotation: The model adopts the review goal, not an open-ended coding task.

steps.content: git diff --stat main...HEAD && git diff main...HEAD -- src/auth/token.ts
steps.annotation: The loop inspects the change with ordinary tools, just as in interactive mode.

steps.content: src/auth/token.ts +48 -6 ; refresh path no longer checks expiry
steps.annotation: The result is appended; the model reasons over the actual diff.

steps.content: Found a real regression: the refresh path dropped the expiry check.
steps.annotation: Review mode optimizes for high-signal findings, not edits.

steps.content: stdout (JSON): { "findings": [ { "title": "Missing expiry check on refresh", "priority": 1, "file": "src/auth/token.ts", "line": 88 } ], "overall_correct": false }
steps.annotation: Review mode serializes findings as JSON so CI and other tools can gate on them.

steps.content: same loop, other doors: codex exec --json in CI (headless), codex cloud (hosted tasks), codex apply (pull the diff locally)
steps.annotation: exec / review / cloud are one harness run unattended; only the front door and output sink differ.

steps.content: Review complete: 1 blocking finding. The same loop runs locally, in CI, or in the cloud.
steps.annotation: The harness leaves your laptop but keeps a single agent loop.
